config.echo_summon.title: Echo Summon Settings
config.echo_summon.enableCustomSaddleIte: Use Echo custom saddle textures (<mount>_saddle_item.png). Disable to use vanilla saddle look.
Render optional overlay under straps (<mount>_saddle_item_body.png) if present.
Apply the enchantment glint effect to the custom mount body overlays.
config.echo_summon.capturedSaddleGlintTe: Enable/disable enchantment glint on the saddle overlay only.
config.echo_summon.capturedBodyGlintTest: Enable/disable a unified glint effect applied to the entire mount body.
config.echo_summon.mountGlintIntensity10: Visual strength of the glint. 1 = faint, 10 = strong.
config.echo_summon.mountGlintColor.toolt: Hex color for the glint (e.g., #FFFFFF). No resource pack needed; this tints the glint at render time.
config.echo_summon.mountGlintOpacity.too: Opacity of the glint overlay. 1 = nearly transparent, 255 = opaque.
config.echo_summon.enableEchoGlintEngine: Use the custom Echo glint renderer with per-entity color/opacity/scroll/scale. Disable to fallback to vanilla glint.
config.echo_summon.mountGlintScrollX.too: Horizontal scroll speed of the glint texture (UV units per second).
config.echo_summon.mountGlintScrollY.too: Vertical scroll speed of the glint texture (UV units per second).
config.echo_summon.mountGlintScaleX.tool: Horizontal scale for the glint texture tiling (0.1 – 8.0).
config.echo_summon.mountGlintScaleY.tool: Vertical scale for the glint texture tiling (0.1 – 8.0).
config.echo_summon.mountGlintMask.skelet: Custom mask: Skeleton Horse (sprite or path)
config.echo_summon.mountGlintMask.zombie: Custom mask: Zombie Horse (sprite or path)
config.echo_summon.mountGlintMask.toolti: Optional. Accepts 'modid:path' sprite id or 'entity/.../name' path. If path is given, it resolves to textures/<path>.png. Leave blank to use the default body asset mask.
